messages:
Maria V: FYI I kicked a tiny-window stitch for EU hourly aggregates — noticed the console preflight shows a huge cost estimate for a 10m window :thinking:
Kai L: Can you paste the job args? we should be able to eyeball if it's doing a full-day scan by mistake
Maria V: Here — `./replayer --tenant=acme --start=2026-03-20T10:00Z --end=2026-03-20T10:10Z --priority=standard`
Alex R: That looks fine. Console preflight probably used the legacy estimator which multiplies by shard count. We've had that bug for narrow windows.
Jeff H: Ugh yep, estimator ignores window length for small windows. It assumes full-shard cost.
Maria V: ops-bot queued: Job 87321 created (tenant=acme, window=10m, est_cost=42.7 CPU-hours) :robot_face:
Maria V: Which is clearly wrong, should be ~0.04 CPU-hours
Kai L: Two short-term options: 1) fix estimator quickly to use sample rates for windows < 1h; 2) add a console guard that clamps displayed cost for windows under X minutes and shows a "detailed estimator" link
Alex R: I prefer 2 for UX so users aren't scared by noise, and 1 as followup to avoid wrong billing signals.
Jeff H: Agreed. Also we need a routing tweak: small-window stitches should auto-route to the "micro-backfill" queue with tighter dedupe and lower token allotment so they don't steal reserved slots.
Maria V: Do we have a micro-backfill queue? I thought that was a design note only.
Alex R: There is an internal queue, but it's opt-in. We can default small windows (<15m) to it, but need to ensure quota calculations and canary fallbacks are wired.
Jeff H: Implementation plan: console change (clamp UI) + API flag `small_window=true` so replayer and scheduler route correctly. I'll sketch the API toggle.
Kai L: Can we do the console clamp as a client-side quick fix? E.g. show "estimated cost: ~0.04 CPU-hours" and a tooltip "legacy estimator spike — clicking details runs full estimator" with a link to /backfill/estimator?
Maria V: That would unblock me now. Could we also add an operator note for on-call: "small-window jobs may show inflated cost, check estimator-v2 if unsure"
Alex R: I'll open a tiny PR for the clamp + tooltip. Jeff, can you add the API flag and scheduler routing check? I'll mock the API change in the console to call `?small_window=true` for windows < 15m.
Jeff H: Yep. I'll add a routing predicate: `if small_window or window_minutes <= 15 -> route micro_backfill_queue` and make dedupe TTL 30s.
Maria V: Thanks! Can we also surface a preflight line item: "estimated shards scanned: X" so people see why cost changed?
Kai L: Good call. Minimal change: show shards_scanned_estimate and sampled_rate. That should improve trust.
ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: CI check queued for PR #5421 (console clamp)
Maria V: Linking internal doc for followups: https://go/redwood/backfill-guide — I'll add a note about small-window behavior.
Alex R: TLDR action items: Alex -> PR for clamp/tooltip + shard line item; Jeff -> API flag + scheduler routing; Kai -> add on-call note to runbook; Maria -> update backfill-guide and re-run your stitch after UI patch.
Jeff H: I'll try to get the scheduler change into canary tonight, test in staging with a 5m job.
Maria V: Perfect, thanks all :thumbsup:
Kai L: If anyone sees weird billing alerts after, ping me and I'll mute noisy alerts until estimator-v2 lands.
Maria V: Will do.
